back.text: huí - to return; to reply; to go back
We invite you to come and work at the company.
back.notes:
Wǒmen qǐng nǐ lái gōngsì gōngzuò.

In this sentence, '來' (lái) is a directional verb meaning 'to come' or 'to arrive'. It indicates movement toward the location of the company ('公司') to perform the action of working ('工作'), linking the invitation to the destination.

back.text: I have a very good friend.
back.notes:
Wǒ yǒu yí ge hěn hǎo de péngyou.

A general measure word linking the numeral “one” to the noun “friend.”

back.text: jǐ - how many; several; a few
kuài - lump; piece; sum of money
bùdàn... érqiě... - not only... but also...
kāi - to open; to start; to operate (a vehicle)
There are no desks in my school.
back.notes:
Wǒ de xuéxiào lǐ méiyǒu zhuōzi.

沒有 (méiyǒu) 是一個否定動詞，意為「沒有」或「不存在」，在句中表示學校裡沒有桌子。

back.text: ne - indicates a question; how about...?;
zhāng - measure word for paper/flat objects

front.text: 今天我想做一點兒好吃的菜。

back.text: Today I want to prepare a few delicious dishes.
back.notes:
Jīntiān wǒ xiǎng zuò yìdiǎnr hǎochī de cài.

A verb meaning “to make” or “to prepare” in relation to food.
